measurement.activation: input to current level lm_head, after final normalization; current generated positions only
measurement.boundary: scores captured before sampling current codes; exported with that completed prefix before any next-level computation
measurement.projection: flatten positions then fixed Rademacher projection divided by sqrt(256)

legacy.pilot: first 128 train identities in lexicographic SHA-256 order
legacy.development_selection_halves: validation groups sorted by SHA-256(study_id + puzzle_id), alternating threshold-selection and assessment groups
legacy.reuse_claim: exposed development feasibility only; never fresh confirmation

new_data.source_status: unresolved; V2-2 source manifest required before any new data capture or fitting
new_data.selection_rule: review unused official hard release first, then at most two licensed Sudoku sources; source eligibility and overlap audited before model outcomes; no task/model change
new_data.eligibility: well-formed clue-consistent unique-solution 9x9 Sudoku; source and difficulty distribution documented; no favorable-outcome selection
new_data.overlap: exact grids plus declared Sudoku-equivalence audit against all legacy and new partitions; any unaudited equivalences and unknown training exposure disclosed
new_data.no_source_route: use legacy partitions once for feasibility; confirmation and downstream phases stay closed

fitting.selection: each fit threshold from validation selection half negatives; rank on other validation half by FPR <= 0.08, then recall, then AUROC, then smaller C; family ties use listed order
fitting.activation_base: best validation-ranked confidence-containing control; fit its union with activation at the two C values
fitting.threshold: strict score > finite-sample upper negative-score quantile; empirical negative exceedance <= 0.05; ties stay negative
fitting.confirmation_threshold: set once on separate calibration negatives after final refit; never refit or change sign on confirmation
fitting.refit: four selected cheap models and one activation model on train+validation only; scalers refitted on that union
fitting.candidate: activation first if development gate passes against all four controls; otherwise best confidence control if gate passes against both non-confidence controls; otherwise stop
fitting.development_gate: separate calibration operating points: recall >= 0.4, FPR <= 0.05, recall lift >= 0.10 over every required comparator; no interval significance required for exploratory selection
fitting.shuffled_diagnostic: one training-label permutation for activation family at selected C; report validation discrimination only; not a candidate or a selection input

confirmation.required_comparators: all four cheap controls for activation; both non-confidence controls for confidence-only branch
confirmation.uncertainty: paired group percentile bootstrap on failure groups for recall differences; every required comparison lower 95% endpoint must exceed zero; conditional on frozen models
confirmation.sparse_data_decision: inconclusive; never extend based on observed significance
confirmation.no_fresh_source_decision: not eligible; no confirmation or online/recovery claims

prospective.interpretation: design sensitivity, not a promise of power or model performance; exact effect/FPR boundary has low gate-passing probability

budget_semantics: single writer persistent ledger; counts starts and failures; GPU-assisted synchronized elapsed stage time conservatively includes host work and loading; enforce between bounded batches/jobs; any indivisible-operation overshoot is recorded as exhausted and prohibits further work; interrupted active operations fail closed
hardware: existing local GPU and one CPU fitting thread; no paid services, new checkpoints, or subagents
stop: measurement failure, missing independent data for confirmation, exhausted budget, failed detector gate, or confirmation failure closes relevant branch; new searches require a new study
